title: Franklin Mint HO Southern Crescent Limited 1396 4-6-2 Steam Locomotive Only 1989
conditionDescription: Locomotive only, no tender/base/box. Paint and decals bright, light dust. Not test-run; sold as a display piece.
descriptionText:
Franklin Mint Precision Models HO scale (1:87) Southern Railway "Crescent Limited" 4-6-2 Pacific steam locomotive, road number 1396. Die-cast body in the Crescent's green and white livery with gold striping, crescent-moon heralds on the cab and cylinders, brass-look piping and handrails, and an American Locomotive Company builder's plate on the smokebox. Marked "(c) 1989 FMPM" on the underside.

Locomotive only - no tender, display base, box or paperwork. Engine measures about 7 inches long.

Condition: Pre-owned. Paint and decals are bright with no chips found; light dust on the boiler top and smokebox, and normal light wear to the running gear. Detail parts, pilot and rear drawbar are all present. Not test-run on track, so it is sold as a display piece. Please review all photos - they are of the actual locomotive you will receive.
